desc: Andy turns and shouts, slamming his hand against the wall.
Michael pulls on a yellow barrier, so Darryl on crutches touches it to stop him.
Michael scrunches his face, tears in his eyes, laughing hard.
Darryl on crutches presses a button on a red industrial machine as its small panel door opens and lifts up.
Dwight leans in trying to peek at the red machine with a strained, grimacing expression while Darryl talking.
Michael stands among other people in a warehouse, looking embarrassed and glancing sideways awkwardly.
Michael hops onto the reception desk while Pam sits behind it and a man leans against it.
A woman yawns widely on a couch beside a man with crutches.
Michael flings his hands up, fingers splayed beside his head.
Michael stands with hands clasped, lightly bouncing on a trampoline in a parking lot.
Dwight scrunches his face and nods, agreeing reluctantly.
Ryan holds up his watch, glancing between it and Kelly talking to him.
Ryan stands up and kisses Kelly on the nose.
Ryan smiles and scoops cash off his desk.
Creed sits at his desk while another man swaps the apple on his desk for a potato.
A group of coworkers gathers as Kevin hands out cash.
Michael and Dwight stand on a rooftop above a parking lot, one gripping a watermelon.
Dwight drops the watermelon from the roof, which bounces off a trampoline below.
The watermelon smashes to pieces on a car.
Dwight takes a binder from the shelf and stands beside Andy, who turns to him.
Dwight in a suit plays air guitar on a rooftop.
Michael peers over a rooftop edge, gripping it tightly.
Dwight runs into the warehouse shouting through a megaphone.
Two pink turrets peek above a tall hedge.
Jim and Pam approach a red and pink inflatable bounce castle outside a building.
Pam and Jim looks up in shock in front of an inflatable red bounce castle.
Pam stands outside shouting through a megaphone, surrounded by people.
Michael climbs down a caged ladder on the side of a building as people applaud below.
Michael hugs Darryl on crutches tightly, pushing him back slightly.
Stanley stares in shock at a car covered in smashed watermelon.
